question: Which additional offspring of attendant goddesses continue the consecratory invocation?
premises: The sons of Śākinī are invoked.
The sons of Hākinī are invoked.
The invocation continues with these groups.
inference: The sons of Śākinī and Hākinī further extend the circle of consecrating powers.
plain_english: Again, may the sons of Śākinī and likewise the sons of Hākinī consecrate you.
